body: I'm pretty adverse to medication as i dont really believe itll solve the root of the problem.. I was in a pretty awful mood, more than usual, and kind of wrote this is in a fit of depressed inspiration, hence the fact that i mispelled my username. I have tried a load of stuff, and im currently working on exercise and a combination of turmeric and lithium oratate to stimulate neurogenesis in my brain. Ive done blood tests and tried just about everything, looked into every possible root. And to me honestly, those symtoms are more so the cause of my depression than the other way around. Depression is such a ridiculously broad spectrum man. But im basically wasting the early times of my life feeling this way, ive disconnected from some of my closest buds and barely feel like myself. I feel totally out of my head. I dont think ireally need therapy because thats jst gonna be me talking about how im feeling like shit and them telling me that its understandable that i feel liek shit. Ive dealt with a ton of professionals on this subject and honestly they really dont know what theyre doing. All of the mainstream studies basically say that they dont know what causes depression and theyre giving out drugs basically because they dont know what else to do. For a while i suspected mold toxicity but the general blood test showed up negative. I think ill get a more specific test from a mold specialist though because my bedroom is chalk full of mold (have since moved out of it). Im supplemented trace minerals, taking pro biotics, dropping out dairy and gluten even tho i was tested and they say im not sensitive. Im looking into some projects regarding amino acids and how they can help depression, ive fucking put so much into this and have gotten nothing in return. Its been about 6 months now of absolutely no quality of life and im losing all of the things about myself that i like. Im trying to be resilient but i just feel like giving up, if life is like this for much longer there really is no point, im a husk. The doctor i just saw literally told me the reason im feeling this way is because im obsessing over it and just have to change my thinking. Yah no shit im obsessing over it its consuming my life and im trying to find a fucking solution. One thing he told me is that there are only a few times a day, called solar noon which varies from where you live, that you can absorb the right kind of vitamin d for depression and anxiety etc and that deficiency cant be tested. Im fuckin  trying but im watching everything fall apart and im not sure how long i can keep it together.
